method: Used temporal smoothing, cosine similarities, calibration-only unsupervised PCA, component removal/whitening, interval resampling, and slope-constrained subsequence DTW. Interpreted overlapping retrieved calibration examples to infer recurring phrases and their order, including have/no followed by music, music followed by is/here, and do/not followed by feel/hungry. No supervised encoder, labeled neural prototypes, or gradient updates were used. Reproducible scripts, retrieval scores, alignment paths, and inference_evidence.json remain in the directory.
limitations: These are unverified best reconstructions. Variable timing, shared onset/offset responses, and weak short-word matches leave boundaries ambiguous. Confidence is particularly low for ta8a65773, t7d52b265, and t53cbb8ea. Competing readings include tell my nurse i am right here and they do not have faith for the latter two queries.
